children: The move brings digital media planning and buying experience from DDB Mudra Group to Hamilton Housewares’ drinkware business

Rashi Bhushan has joined Hamilton Housewares, which owns the Milton brand, as Assistant General Manager– Marketing and Omnichannel Media, effective September 2026. Based in Mumbai, she will lead marketing and omnichannel media for the company’s drinkware business. Bhushan brings experience spanning digital strategy, media planning and buying, client management and campaign execution, having worked across advertising and media agencies including DDB Mudra Group, Madison World, Mindshare and Span Digital.

Before joining Hamilton Housewares, Bhushan served as Associate Vice President for Digital Media Planning and Buying at DDB Mudra Group from April 2021 to August 2026. Her responsibilities included digital strategy, media planning and buying, and leading media initiatives. She also held the role of Senior Partner – Integrated Strategy and Media during part of her tenure at the group.

Her work at DDB Mudra followed a career in digital marketing and media planning across multiple agencies, with experience in campaign strategy, client relations and execution across different sectors.

Bhushan worked as Business Director at Madison World from July 2018 to November 2020. In that role, she handled digital and client responsibilities for Tata Consumer Products, Welspun and other accounts, covering brand communication, media planning and buying, campaign ideation and client servicing.

Earlier, she worked as Director– Digital at Mindshare between May 2017 and January 2018, handling media planning and buying for clients including Castrol, Star India and Facebook. Her responsibilities included market and competition analysis, pitch presentations and digital initiatives.

From May 2015 to April 2017, Bhushan was Senior Account Director– Digital at Span Digital. She led client servicing, digital strategy and media planning across public- and private-sector accounts, with work spanning display, mobile, social media, search, performance marketing and website initiatives.

At Hamilton Housewares, Bhushan’s role covers marketing and omnichannel media for drinkware. The appointment brings agency-side experience in digital planning and buying into a role focused on a consumer products business.

Omnichannel marketing connects brand communication and consumer engagement across digital and physical touchpoints. For consumer goods companies, the approach can bring media planning, brand visibility and purchasing journeys into closer alignment. Bhushan’s experience across digital strategy and integrated media is relevant to this remit.

Bhushan holds a postgraduate diploma in management, specialising in marketing and human resources, from the Institute of Management Studies, Ghaziabad. She completed the programme in 2010 after earning a bachelor’s degree in English and economics from Isabella Thoburn College.
